rules.rationale: A13 forced libselinux is_selinux_enabled() to return false globally. Known-good AOSP16 and Android-16 retain normal mounted-policy detection, and the promotion has already closed SELinux/APEX boot blockers without disabling enforcement. Reapplying this patch would make userspace mis-detect policy state and bypass security initialization rather than solve a current compatibility gap.
rules.necessity: Not necessary on the validated Android 16 baseline and explicitly contrary to current security requirements.
rules.performance: The forced return saves only a trivial mount-state check; any boot-time benefit is negligible.
rules.security: Critical negative impact: globally reports SELinux disabled, can suppress labeling/policy-aware behavior and hides enforcement state from components. It must not be promoted.
validation_evidence: A13 source patch and final AOSP16/Android-16 enabled.c were compared; both Android 16 trees use normal selinux_mnt detection. Existing promotion records include SELinux APEX boot closure without this patch.

rules.rationale: A13 added trailing atlas storage to tolerate a goldfish glTexSubImage2D encoder over-read. In current Skia the Plot allocation moved to AtlasTypes.cpp. Android 16 allocates fBytesPerPixel * fWidth * (fHeight + 1) in both lazy allocation paths, preserving the root fix and covering a full extra row instead of A13's format-dependent fWidth-byte margin.
rules.necessity: Required to prevent intermittent out-of-bounds reads and crashes in Play Store, Instagram, Facebook, Settings and other atlas-heavy applications when using goldfish-opengl-pie.
rules.performance: Adds one zeroed row per allocated atlas Plot. Memory overhead is bounded by plot width and bytes per pixel; no additional per-draw computation beyond the allocation-size arithmetic.
rules.security: Prevents out-of-bounds reads by the graphics encoder. The larger full-row margin is safer across multi-byte color formats than the original byte-only margin.
validation_evidence: A13 GrDrawOpAtlas allocation and current AtlasTypes Plot allocation paths were compared; target commit 0b9c6137 modifies both dataAt and prepForRender lazy allocations. Graphics runtime regression remains pending.
